sources.title: PeopleGroups.org — Rohingya of Myanmar (PGID PG022052)
sources.locator: Fast facts, Bengali (ben), Sunni Islam, GSEC and resources

sources.title: Rohingya emergency
sources.locator: Rohingya displacement, statelessness and regional refugee situation

whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the PeopleGroups.org Rohingya record in Myanmar. Humanitarian context is included because statelessness and displacement materially shape present-day access conditions, without reducing Rohingya identity to crisis alone.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies this record under Sunni Islam. The source-level category does not describe every Rohingya individual's belief or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The profile separates PeopleGroups mission-status evidence from UNHCR-documented humanitarian constraints. Neither Rohingya ethnicity nor Islam is treated as an inherent cause of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Displacement and statelessness shape access conditions
whyUnreached.summary: UNHCR documents a large, protracted Rohingya refugee and statelessness crisis across Myanmar and neighboring countries, creating substantial mobility, protection and service constraints.

whyUnreached.heading: Current mission-status evidence
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports this Myanmar source record below its evangelical threshold with no active church-planting activity in its GSEC label.

whyUnreached.heading: Bengali-language resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Bengali Bible and film resources for this source record's language context, so resource listing and actual access are kept analytically separate.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG022052 / PEID 22052 as Rohingya in Myanmar and currently associates the record with Bengali (ben); UNHCR separately identifies Rohingya from Myanmar as a stateless and displaced population across the region.
claims.interpretationNote: PeopleGroups language metadata is preserved as source data; it is not used here to settle wider linguistic or ethnographic debates about Rohingya language identity.

claims.text: UNHCR reports a protracted Rohingya displacement and statelessness situation involving more than one million refugees in Bangladesh and Rohingya remaining displaced or stateless inside Myanmar; these conditions can constrain stable access to services, communities and travel.
claims.interpretationNote: This contextual claim describes documented humanitarian conditions and does not assert that displacement alone determines the provider's GSEC classification.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG022052 under Sunni Islam.
claims.interpretationNote: This is an aggregate provider classification, not an individual religious claim.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently labels PG022052 'Less than 2% Evangelical, No Active CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: This is the provider's current mission-status label for this exact Myanmar source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Bengali-language Bible and film resources associated with the record.
claims.interpretationNote: Resource availability does not establish whether displaced or stateless Rohingya can obtain, understand or use those resources.
